units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:12">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שהע׳ שאני עובר קשה היא</he> severe is the anger with which I am filled. Tanḥ. Vaëthḥ. 6 <he>נתמלא הקב״ה בע׳ עליו</he> the Lord was filled with anger at him (with ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 3:26">Deut. III, 26</cite>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 820:8">Yalk. Deut. 820</cite> (expl. <he>ויתעבר</he>, Deut. l. c.) <he>נתמלא עלי ע׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:5">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>שהיא אוספת את הע׳</he> it calls in the wrath (i.e. it is a sign of forgiveness, with ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 85:4">Ps. LXXXV, 4</cite>); a. fr.
